concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑004 (data‑collection completeness ≥ 25 valid sessions out of 30) is not explicitly addressed in the plan. Phase 5 only states that a synthetic driver creates 30 participant sessions, but does not specify a check or guarantee that at least 25 of them are valid (i.e., not aborted or corrupted). The plan should include a validation step that enforces or verifies this retention requirement before proceeding to analysis.
